meta.title: Pulse / Frame — Generative Word‑Graph
meta.description: An original minimalist, loop‑driven lexicon for spoken dance‑poetry. Each token suggests three next words: perfect rhyme, slant/assonance, and semantic neighbor.
usage_notes: Weights bias toward rhyme first, then slant, then motif neighbor. Adjust to taste.
Interleave families to keep the ear engaged; land on semantic neighbors to pivot scenes.
Silence is a word: insert rests between tokens for breath and shape.
